*Instructor traveling — Unit 1 concludes, Unit 2 begins*

| Session | Date | Topic | Format |

**Session 8 (Guest Lecture):** Introduction to ML for causal inference from an applied health economics perspective. Bridge to Unit 2.

### Week 6: Unit 1 Wrap-Up & ML Foundations (Feb 16-18)

*Schedule adjusted: Unit 1 material extended due to snow cancellations and pacing.*

| Session | Date | Topic | Format |
|---------|------|-------|--------|
| 10 | Mon Feb 16 | Unit 1 Wrap-Up: Power, Variance Reduction, Blocking & ICC · [Recording](https://zoom.us/clips/share/5yjdTz0WQYaC2dGrKLN82w) | In-Person |
| 11 | Wed Feb 18 | ML Basics & Regression in High Dimensions (Session 2.1) · [Recording](https://zoom.us/clips/share/t5Yvbe0TSdCRqDhrQe7Ofg) | In-Person |

**Due:** Problem Set 1 (February 25 at 11:15am)

**Session 11 Preparation (Required):**

- Watch: Jann Spiess videos (~90 min total)
  - [Applied ML: An Introduction](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=G5qrBvOmzes)
  - [Applied ML: Secret Sauce](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Qs6JmdNoT-Y)
  - [Applied ML: Prediction vs Estimation](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=e2Nmlk0cbrY)
- Read: ISLR Chapters 2 (Statistical Learning), 5 (Cross-Validation)

**Key Concepts (Session 10):** MDE, power curves, simulation-based power, DeclareDesign/MIDA, blocking/stratification, covariate adjustment, Lin (2013) estimator, ICC, multiple hypothesis testing

**Key Concepts (Session 2.1):** Prediction vs. causal estimation (Y-hard vs. β-hard), bias-variance tradeoff, cross-validation, regularization (Lasso/Ridge), LASSO variable selection and instability
